messages:
Mira R: FYI bringing up hf/model-x-3b and hit a weird tokenizer split issue during quantization eval. tokenizer_config.json and tokenizer.json disagree on special tokens and chat template.
Sam L: ugh, which fields specifically?
Mira R: tokenizer_config.json only has `unk_token` and `pad_token` but tokenizer.json (the fast tokenizer) includes `additional_special_tokens` ["<SYS>", "<USR>", "<ASSISTANT>"] and a `chat_template` mapping. conversion script dropped those.
Jonah: do we have files? ls output?
Mira R: pasted: ```
$ ls -1 model-x-3b/tokenizer*
tokenizer.json
tokenizer_config.json
vocab.json
merges.txt
```
Mira R: tokenizer.json snippet: ```json
{"special_tokens_map": {"additional_special_tokens": ["<SYS>", "<USR>"]}, "version": "0.1"}
```
Mira R: tokenizer_config.json: ```json
{"pad_token": "<pad>", "unk_token": "<unk>"}
```
Kai: so the fast -> slow conversion lost `additional_special_tokens` and the chat template. That explains the chat eval failures (system prompt tokens are tokenized differently).
Sam L: observed quantization perf drop on evals: Rouge and EM took ~3-4% hit, but logs looked like bad truncation and extra tokens in system messages.
Jonah: can we repro deterministically? run `redwood-convert --check-specials`?
Mira R: ran that, output: ```
[WARN] missing additional_special_tokens in tokenizer_config.json
[ERROR] chat_template refers to <SYS> but not present in tokenizer_config
```
CI Bot: build #5123 reported tokenizer mismatch on model-x-3b during onboarding pipeline. See https://ci.redwood.local/builds/5123 (internal).
Kai: temporary mitigation: add a sideloader that merges tokenizer.json extras into tokenizer_config.json before conversion. But long-term we should make conversion idempotent: if fast tokenizer has specials, propagate them.
Sam L: I pushed a tiny script `scripts/sync_specials.py` that copies additional_special_tokens into tokenizer_config.json and rewrites chat_template keys to use tokens in tokenizer_config. dropping it into onboarding step fixes the eval. PR: https://git.redwood/sync/987
Mira R: ran quantization eval after patch — perplexity on eval set returned to baseline, generation alignment improved. Will attach eval artifacts.
Mira R: action items: 1) patch redwood-convert to preserve `additional_special_tokens` (Kai) 2) add a unit test in onboarding pipeline for chat_template roundtrip (Jonah) 3) re-run quantization sweep for model-x-3b and upload results (Mira).
Jonah: I'll own the unit test. quick note: add a check for `merges.txt` presence too — some HF fast->slow combos drop merges and confuse BPE split.
Sam L: +1 on merges check. Also add an alert if token counts differ > 2% between tokenizers. :eyes:
Mira R: copying final repro steps in the ticket: ```
# repro
git checkout model-x-3b
python -m redwood_convert --input . --output ./converted
python -m scripts.sync_specials ./converted/tokenizer.json ./converted/tokenizer_config.json
redwood-onboard --model ./converted
# run quant eval
python -m evals.run --model ./converted --sweep quant.yaml
```
Mira R: attaching small diff and eval link in tracking issue #4521. pinging @Kai for the conversion patch. :thumbsup:
Kai: got it, will open PR today.
